mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_upgrade_record WHERE upgrade_batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM agent_upgrade_record WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM agent_upgrade_record ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET (#{page} - 1) * #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_upgrade_record (upgrade_batch_id, target_version, node_id, node_name, old_version, status, error_message, start_time, end_time, create_time) VALUES (#{upgradeBatchId}, #{targetVersion}, #{nodeId}, #{nodeName}, #{oldVersion}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_upgrade_record SET status = #{status} WHERE upgrade_batch_id = #{batchId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM agent_upgrade_record a INNER JOIN ( SELECT node_id, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM agent_upgrade_record GROUP BY node_id ) b ON a.node_id = b.node_id AND a.create_time = b.max_time ORDER BY a.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
